comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this issue. The report identifies the behavior ("Keyboard Manager Shortcut doesn't work upon opening new programs."), but additional diagnostic evidence is needed to determine the exact failure mechanism and isolate whether this is a code regression or configuration issue.

Please provide:
1. Numbered steps that reproduce the problem from a clean PowerToys start, including exact Windows and PowerToys versions.
2. A fresh diagnostic archive captured immediately after reproducing by adding a comment containing /bugreport.

These details will help us investigate the failing path and prepare a targeted fix.
